svg.aria-label: orchestrator, what is running? argus: Workmatic's invoice pilot invoice → extraction → six checks → proposed posting → accountant confirms 18 export adapters, NetSuite and SAF-T among them · 117 integration tests. models: one way to call several LLM providers, with retry and fallback. inference: self-hosted Qwen and Llama, for data that has to stay on premises. agents: a pipeline that takes software work from plan to review, built with my co-founder; a person approves every stage. game servers: the day job: provisioning, realms and configuration on Kubernetes.
